entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A sphinx mind mage from Vryn who tutored Jace Beleren and was later killed by him.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Plane with two warring factions arbitrated by Alhammarret.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker, Alhammarret's apprentice whose spark ignited when he entered his master's mind.

events.summary: Alhammarret trains Jace and sends him to gather information from the opposing camps.
events.quote: Alhammarret started sending Jace out to gather information

events.summary: Jace enters his master's mind, triggering his spark; Alhammarret pulls him back and wipes the memory.
events.quote: The shock of success and the power of Alhammarret's mind triggered his spark

events.summary: Jace discovers Alhammarret was playing both factions against each other and keeping the war going.
events.quote: Alhammarret was playing both warring factions against each other

events.summary: In a final confrontation Jace damages Alhammarret's mind, making him forget how to breathe, at the cost of his own memories of home, then planeswalks away.
events.quote: Jace damaged the sphinx's mind, removing his knowledge of how to breathe

events.summary: Authorities find Alhammarret dead from lack of oxygen and Jace missing, assumed dead.
events.quote: The authorities found Alhammarret dead from lack of oxygen and Jace missing.

relations.quote: who tutored and was later killed by Jace Beleren

relations.note: removed his knowledge of how to breathe
